about.label: About GG Autos
about.title: The yard behind the buses
about.standfirst: GG Autos assembles, sells and distributes mini buses from Okota, Lagos. We are the automotive arm of GG Bearers, an operating holding company trading in import, export, retail and wholesale.

groupBand.label: Part of a group
groupBand.title: GG Bearers
groupBand.body: GG Autos is one of two subsidiaries of GG Bearers, alongside GG Foods. The group trades in import, export, retail and wholesale, and its motto, integrity is our first priority, is the standard the yard is held to.

mission.label: Our mission
mission.title: World class vehicles that serve their purpose
points: We ensure every vehicle meets global safety and performance standards.
We are committed to reducing carbon emissions and to supplying sound vehicles to our customers, building long-term relationships, trust and service excellence.
We have always held integrity as our first priority.

story.label: How we work
story.title: A workshop first, a showroom second
paragraphs: Most people in this trade buy finished vehicles and resell them. We started from the other end. Component parts come into the workshop in Okota and leave as complete passenger buses, coupled, wired, trimmed and road-tested by the people who work here.

That order matters. Because we build, we know what is inside every unit we sell, we can specify a bus around the route it will actually run, and we can put a fault right instead of passing a buyer down a chain of suppliers.

The rest of the business follows from the workshop. Retail sales for drivers and owners buying one bus. Wholesale distribution for dealers, fleet operators and transport companies buying in volume. Both are served from the same yard, to the same standard.

team.remit: Group direction, commercial partnerships and wholesale relationships.
Coupling, attachment and joining, build quality and the inspection sign-off.
Retail buyers, unit enquiries and the handover process.
Volume orders, batch scheduling and delivery.

values.title: Say the condition out loud
values.body: New, foreign used and locally used mean different things and carry different risks. Every listing states which it is, the mileage, and where the unit shows its age.

values.title: Papers before price
values.body: Duty, registration and ownership documents are in order before a unit goes on the yard. A cheap bus with incomplete papers is not a cheap bus.

values.title: Inspection is welcome
values.body: Bring your own mechanic. Put it on a lift. We would rather lose a sale to an honest inspection than win one that comes back.

values.title: The builder answers the phone
values.body: Nothing is subcontracted out of sight. The yard that coupled your bus is the yard you call when you need something.

points.title: Importation and clearing
points.body: Importation of the goods, and clearing of the goods, for our own yard and for the wider GG Bearers group.

points.title: Joining and coupling
points.body: Joining and coupling, as well as wiring systems.
